title: docsrs-cli JSON error envelope
description: Top-level JSON written on failure when JSON output is selected. Not nested under data. Camada Y: top-level command + duration_ms match success envelopes for agent correlation.

command.description: Wire command name (get-item, search-crates, usage, cache-path, …). usage when clap fails before dispatch.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the attempt in milliseconds (0 for early parse/config failures)

kind.description: Stable snake_case ErrorKind discriminant on the wire. Enumerated here as well as described, because a description is prose and a validator cannot reject a kind that only prose forbids. budget = local body/output budget exceeded (exit 74, retryable=false). io = local filesystem failure caused by the environment (exit 74); retryable reflects the OS cause, so a full disk is retryable and a permission denial is not. Exit 74 is shared by network, budget and io and is ambiguous until this field is read. canceled covers SIGINT/SIGTERM (exit 130/143); internal Interrupted/Terminated map to canceled on the wire.

retryable.description: True only for transient failures (rate_limited, unavailable, timeout, network, and io when the OS cause can clear). budget is permanent for the same config. For io the answer comes from the underlying errno, not from the kind: ENOSPC is retryable and EACCES is not, and both arrive as kind=io at exit 74.

retry_after_secs.description: Omitted when absent; never JSON null

suggestions.description: Ranked --suggest alternatives, best first. Present only on a not-found whose recovery ladder produced at least one candidate; omitted otherwise, never JSON null and never an empty array. The same list is also spelled into message for humans — read it here instead of splitting that sentence apart.

path.description: Item path to retype (option::Option::unwrap), without the crate prefix

kind.description: CLI kind to pass alongside path (method, variant, struct, …). This is the kind the caller would retype, not the rustdoc anchor family: labelling an associated type as method would send them back into the same not-found.
